title: Generated OpenAPI reference composition and frontend dispatch parity

phases.objective: Prove that the OpenAPI Auto Sync conversion of reviewed Support Ticket inline operations to external path-item references preserves resolvable contracts, runtime authorization parity, no-send consequential classification, route coverage, and deterministic frontend dispatch evidence.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository OpenAPI and frontend contract governance
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact generated root OpenAPI and frontend dispatch evidence committed from OpenAPI Auto Sync run 30756584697
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every reviewed Support Ticket reference resolves to the registered precise contract, completion certification remains no-send and non-consequential, runtime/OpenAPI authorization stays equivalent, route coverage has no gaps, and frontend dispatch regeneration is deterministic.
steps: Validate migration from historical inline Support Ticket contracts to registered path-item references.
Validate the exact completion-certification legacy transition and its idempotent follow-up check.
Validate precise Admin execution, brand, remaining, and completion OpenAPI contracts against the Support Ticket runtime routes.
Validate generated frontend surface dispatch against source-pinned OpenAPI authority.
Validate frontend runtime authorization alternatives against OpenAPI security declarations.
Validate root and referenced OpenAPI route coverage with no undocumented runtime gaps.
assertions: The root OpenAPI uses only resolvable reviewed local references for the converted Support Ticket path items.
Path and HTTP method coverage is preserved after reference composition.
Operation identifiers, request and response contracts, authentication alternatives, and consequential classifications remain precise.
Completion certification resolves exactly to `./openapi/support-ticket-runtime-completion.yaml#/certifyAdminSupportTicketExternalDeliveryCompletion` and remains `x-openai-isConsequential: false`.
Generated frontend dispatch and runtime-route evidence are deterministic and source-pinned.
A lower count of operations physically inline in the root document is not treated as coverage loss when exact referenced contracts resolve and route coverage remains complete.
No Migration 1043 Apply, activation registry synchronization, provider call, credential access, external send, deployment, Production mutation, or secret inclusion occurs.

phases.objective: Merge the reviewed generated contracts to main and require the next OpenAPI Auto Sync run to report no residual generated drift.
Keep unresolved references, authorization drift, consequential-classification drift, route gaps, and stale frontend evidence fail-closed.
Rebuild a fresh exact-main-tree Production candidate after the generated contracts are merged.
Promote only through separately authorized Production governance after exact-candidate validation.
